title: Find Lucky Integer in an Array
summary: Given an array of integers, identify the highest integer whose occurrence matches its value.
statement: Given an array of integers, identify the highest integer whose occurrence matches its value. If no such integer exists, return -1.
constraints: An integer is lucky when its value equals its frequency in arr.
Return the largest lucky integer, or -1 when none exists.
hints: Keep values whose count equals the value itself.
Return their maximum, using -1 as the empty default.
The equality is precisely the lucky definition.
editorial: The equality is precisely the lucky definition.

tests.explanation: Two occurs exactly twice and is the largest lucky value.
One, two, and three are lucky; three is largest.
